# QIXARC

> Web design, development and digital products. Based in Madurai, India; international project enquiries welcome.

## Official pages
- [QIXARC](https://www.qixarc.com/): QIXARC builds business websites, e-commerce experiences and digital products. Based in India and welcoming international clients. Discuss your project.
- [Our Story & QBit](https://www.qixarc.com/story/): Meet QBit, QIXARC’s digital companion, and follow our journey from early ideas to software, AI and automation products.
- [Digital Products: Scaler Profile, Serlow & AI](https://www.qixarc.com/products/): Explore Scaler Profile, Zevaris AI, Serlow and Decision Sphere: QIXARC products for messaging, intelligent assistance, teamwork and mobile assistance.
- [Web Design, Development & UI/UX Services](https://www.qixarc.com/services/): Plan your business website, online store or custom digital system with QIXARC. Explore our services and how we work with international clients.
- [About Our Team](https://www.qixarc.com/about/): Meet QIXARC in Madurai and our leadership: Kabibalan, Founder; Sri, Co-founder; and Giri, Managing Director. Explore their portfolios.
- [Research & Development](https://www.qixarc.com/research/): Explore QIXARC’s research into human-guided AI, interfaces in motion and connected workflows, with updates from our R&D desk.
- [Design & Technology Blog](https://www.qixarc.com/blog/): Read QIXARC’s design and technology journal: ideas about useful interfaces, purposeful animation and digital product development.
- [Contact QIXARC](https://www.qixarc.com/contact/): Contact QIXARC in Madurai about websites, UI/UX design and digital products. Send a project enquiry or email qixarc@gmail.com.
- [Motion should have a purpose](https://www.qixarc.com/blog/motion-with-purpose/): A QIXARC design note on page transitions, feedback and making room for people who prefer less movement.

## Product status
Scaler Profile: development / early access. Zevaris AI: coming soon. Serlow: alpha / in development, https://serlow-alpha.vercel.app/. Decision Sphere: coming soon; an agentic mobile AI in development, with voice or text commands and user-controlled access to mobile data and apps.
